clusters.name: Church space rental
clusters.description: Rent a hall or building to small congregations without their own space, for recurring monthly rent.

clusters.name: Bookable amenity pods in host venues
clusters.description: Place a karaoke room, tanning booth, nap pod, sauna pod or golf simulator inside a gym, bar or other host venue and charge per session, sharing revenue with the host.

clusters.name: Private dog field rental
clusters.description: Rent a fenced private field by the hour to dog owners through a marketplace, earning per-dog hourly fees.

clusters.name: Private office/phone booth rental
clusters.description: Rent a small private office or phone booth by the hour or day to remote workers.

clusters.name: Private pool rental by the hour
clusters.description: Rent private pool access by the hour or day through pool-sharing platforms such as Swimply.

clusters.name: Baby gear rental
clusters.description: Rent cribs, strollers and other travel baby gear to visiting families, with local delivery, priced per day.

clusters.name: Self-storage facility ownership
clusters.description: Build, buy or operate self-storage facilities and rent units to people and businesses for monthly rent.

clusters.name: Portable/container self-storage on land
clusters.description: Place shipping containers or portable storage units on cheap or leased land and rent them out monthly.

clusters.name: Commercial equipment rental with service
clusters.description: Rent water coolers, ice machines or dishwashers to offices and restaurants for a monthly fee that includes maintenance, sometimes with consumables.

clusters.name: Roll-off dumpster rental
clusters.description: Rent roll-off dumpsters to contractors and homeowners, charged per rental with weight overage fees.

clusters.name: Portable toilet rental and servicing
clusters.description: Rent and service portable toilets for construction sites and events, billed monthly or per event.

clusters.name: Luxury restroom trailer rental
clusters.description: Buy luxury restroom trailers and rent them out for weddings and events, charged per event.

clusters.name: Medical/mobility equipment rental
clusters.description: Rent mobility scooters, wheelchairs, knee scooters and hospital beds to tourists and post-surgery patients by the week.

clusters.name: Prop and furniture rental for productions
clusters.description: Rent props, vintage furniture and set dressing to film crews, photographers and event planners, charged per week.

clusters.name: Iconic movie vehicle/prop rental
clusters.description: Buy famous film and TV vehicles or props and rent them to superfans, events and photo shoots, charged per use.

clusters.name: Peer-to-peer car rental (Turo)
clusters.description: List cars on Turo and grow the fleet over time, earning per-trip rental income.

clusters.name: RV/camper/camper van rental
clusters.description: Buy or consign campers, motorhomes or camper vans and rent them nightly through peer-to-peer platforms or direct booking.

clusters.name: Boat rental business
clusters.description: Rent boats to tourists at lakes, earning per-rental fees.

clusters.name: Campsite/RV pads on private land
clusters.description: Rent private land for tent camping, RV pads or outdoor storage, charged nightly or monthly through camping platforms.

clusters.name: Glamping and unique rural stays on land
clusters.description: Add glamping tents, domes, cabins or campers to rural land and rent them nightly on Airbnb or Hipcamp.

clusters.name: RV park/campground ownership
clusters.description: Acquire or operate an RV park or campground and earn nightly or seasonal site rent.

clusters.name: Mobile home park ownership
clusters.description: Acquire and operate a mobile home park, earning lot rent from residents.

clusters.name: Destination short-term vacation rentals
clusters.description: Develop or convert distinctive properties (barns, warehouses, cabins, couples retreats, tiny-town homes) into short-term rentals with nightly bookings.

clusters.name: Airbnb rental arbitrage
clusters.description: Lease a property with the landlord's permission, furnish it, and earn the spread from short-stay bookings over the rent.

clusters.name: Mid-term furnished rentals
clusters.description: Rent furnished homes to travel nurses and other travelling workers for 3+ months via Furnish Finder.

clusters.name: Long-term residential rentals
clusters.description: Own residential homes and rent them to long-term tenants.

clusters.name: Commercial property leasing
clusters.description: Own commercial or industrial buildings and lease them to business tenants long term.

clusters.name: Grazing land lease
clusters.description: Lease idle pasture or cropland to local ranchers and farmers for cash rent.

clusters.name: Hunting/fishing access lease
clusters.description: Lease seasonal hunting and fishing access on land to clubs and outfitters, priced per acre per year.

clusters.name: Standing timber sale
clusters.description: Sell mature timber to mills through sealed bids run by a consulting forester.

clusters.name: Event-day parking on land
clusters.description: Park cars on grass near stadiums and event venues on event days, charged per car.

clusters.name: Truck/contractor storage and parking yards
clusters.description: Rent gravel yard space, trailer stalls, equipment parking and add-on container boxes or offices to contractors and fleets by the month.

clusters.name: Spare parking/storage space rental
clusters.description: List spare land, a garage, a basement or a parking spot on marketplaces for monthly rent.

clusters.name: Solar land lease
clusters.description: Lease acreage to solar developers long term for annual per-acre rent.

clusters.name: Aggregate extraction royalties
clusters.description: Lease sand, gravel and topsoil extraction rights to operators for per-ton royalties.

clusters.name: Peer-to-peer EV charging
clusters.description: Make a private EV charger available to drivers through a charging marketplace and earn per-session fees.

clusters.name: Tesla Supercharger site hosting
clusters.description: Contract with Tesla to host Supercharger equipment on a suitable property and earn site-hosting income.

clusters.name: Trailer/equipment sublease arbitrage
clusters.description: Lease semi-trailers or other equipment from large lessors and sublease them weekly to truckers and businesses at a markup.

clusters.name: Event dress rental
clusters.description: Buy in-demand event or bridesmaid dresses and rent each garment repeatedly.

clusters.name: Designer clothing rental subscription
clusters.description: Rent rotating designer clothing and accessories to subscribers for a subscription fee.

clusters.name: Tool and DIY equipment rental
clusters.description: Rent pressure washers, log splitters and other tools to homeowners per day or weekend, with a deposit.

clusters.name: Heavy equipment rental
clusters.description: Buy skid steers, excavators or trenchers and rent them per day to DIYers and contractors, often via Facebook Marketplace.

clusters.name: Portable hot tub rental
clusters.description: Deliver portable hot tubs and rent them per weekend, week or month to consumers and vacation hosts.

clusters.name: Utility trailer rental yard
clusters.description: Rent utility, cargo and dump trailers from contactless self-pickup lots, charged per day plus a deposit, and replicate across towns.

clusters.name: Golf cart rental for events
clusters.description: Deliver golf carts to weddings, events and campgrounds and charge per day.

clusters.name: Recreational gear rental
clusters.description: Rent lawn games and paddle boards to local customers via Facebook Marketplace, charged per rental period.

clusters.name: Mobile sauna and cold plunge rental
clusters.description: Drop off mobile saunas and cold plunges for day, weekend or week rentals, plus pop-up events.

clusters.name: Boat slip rental
clusters.description: Rent out a waterfront boat slip for the season, priced by boat length.

clusters.name: Costume and mascot suit rental
clusters.description: Rent mascot suits and costumes to schools, teams and individuals, charged per day.

clusters.name: Business records storage
clusters.description: Store and retrieve records for law firms, clinics and accountants, charged per box per month plus retrieval fees.

clusters.name: Climate-controlled wine storage
clusters.description: Store wine for restaurants and collectors, charged monthly per case or bottle.

clusters.name: Aircraft hangar and tie-down rental
clusters.description: Build or lease hangar and tie-down space at small airfields and rent it monthly to aircraft owners.

clusters.name: Container farm leasing
clusters.description: Own hydroponic container farms and lease them monthly to growers who cannot buy one outright.

clusters.name: Inflatable/bounce house rental
clusters.description: Rent bounce houses, water slides and other inflatables for parties and events, charged per rental.

clusters.name: Kids party themed rentals
clusters.description: Rent themed kids' party furniture, play equipment and slumber party tents with delivery, charged per event.

clusters.name: Inflatable movie theater rental
clusters.description: Rent outdoor or indoor inflatable movie theater setups for kids' parties, HOAs and schools as per-event packages.

clusters.name: Event tables, chairs and tent rental
clusters.description: Rent tables, chairs, tents, heaters and similar equipment for weddings and events, per item or as a package.

clusters.name: Specialty wedding decor and bar rentals
clusters.description: Build or buy statement items such as arches, LED dance floors, lemonade carts and tap bars and rent them per event.

clusters.name: Food truck space sublet
clusters.description: Sublet spare lot space to a food truck for a flat monthly fee.

clusters.name: Washer/dryer and appliance rental
clusters.description: Buy or repair used appliances and rent them monthly with delivery and maintenance, including rent-to-own options.

clusters.name: Reusable moving box rental
clusters.description: Rent reusable plastic moving boxes to people who are moving.

clusters.name: Mobile kitchen rental
clusters.description: Rent mobile kitchens and ranges to catering companies.

clusters.name: Commercial kitchen rental directory
clusters.description: Run a directory that charges commercial kitchens to list hourly or daily rental space for food startups.

clusters.name: Bee pollination colony rental
clusters.description: Rent bee colonies to almond growers during bloom, charged per colony.

clusters.name: Photo/film location rental
clusters.description: Rent a scenic home or land to photographers and film crews by the hour or day.

clusters.name: Covered building space rental
clusters.description: Rent metal building or barndominium space monthly to businesses for storage or workshops.

clusters.name: Youth sports training venue
clusters.description: Rent indoor courts or practice space to coaches and youth athletes through memberships or hourly fees.
